coverage_progress_current_state.interpretation: RL=9 across all 4 windows — no new shapes learned. coverage_progress=false requires reachable_learned strictly increasing. Stagnant.

s4a_gate_audit.root_cause: Reachable_learned count is flat at 9 across all windows. The system executes activity templates but the coverage_tick resolver sees no new shape learning. F-068 (task_count=0) means output impulses are not stored in traces, so coverage_tick cannot observe shape output progression from recent executions — it falls back to template output_shapes, but those were already present in older windows too.
s4a_gate_audit.s4a_unblocked_claim: The validator iter-27 claim 'S.4a measurement unblocked' is ACCURATE in the narrow sense that coverage-tick can now execute (it ran at 09:40). It is NOT accurate if interpreted as 'S.4a will be satisfied soon' — coverage_progress is false and will remain so until RL increases.
s4a_gate_audit.what_would_close_s4a: New templates must be seeded or created (increasing reachable_learned above 9) across successive 1h windows.

s4b_gate_audit.spec_requirement: S.4b: most recent substrateHealthReport has health_verdict.overall_passing=true

root_causes.confidence_passing_false: median_alpha_plus_beta=2, pairs_above_floor(10)=0. Thompson posteriors still near-prior for most templates. Only validator-dispatch (α=135) and create-shape-provider-goal (β=22) have meaningful posteriors.
root_causes.stability_passing_false: new_templates_added=28 in the 1h window (all templates appeared fresh after container restart ~09:03Z), mutation_rate_per_hour=28. The substrate-health-tick interprets mass template addition as instability.
root_causes.vessels_passing_false: boredom-vessel shows as inactive. This is a false negative — boredom-vessel is a one-shot systemd timer (Type=oneshot), appears inactive between 5-min fires. The health-tick design treats one-shot inactive state as unhealthy.
